Running command: python3 -c "
# Let me check: what is the default cache size?
# IOStreamBuffer(size_t cache = 4096 * 4096) -> 16MB
# For a 20MB file, m_cacheSize = 16MB (since 20MB > 16MB)
# m_numBlocks = ceil(20/16) = 2
# First readNextBlock reads 16MB, m_cachePos goes from 0 to 16MB
# i goes from 0 to 16MB
# Then m_cachePos >= m_cacheSize, readNextBlock reads remaining 4MB
# m_cacheSize becomes 4MB (since readLen < m_cacheSize)
# i continues from 16MB to 20MB
# buffer was resized to 16MB, so buffer[16MB] is OOB

# But wait - the line is a comment starting with '#'
# In getNextDataLine, the loop processes each char
# When it hits the newline at the end, it breaks
# So i would be 20MB (the line length)
# buffer[i] = '\n' at line 291 would write at index 20MB
# buffer was resized to 16MB, so this is OOB

print('Analysis complete')
"
